og.alt: Migrate (Pyreon Compat): Keep your React code. Move to Pyreon one screen at a time.

hero.alt: Top: a React Counter that runs unchanged on @pyreon/react-compat: useState, a derived const, setCount in the click handler. Bottom: the same component converted to Pyreon: signal(0), computed(() => count() * 2), count.update in the handler, props.step instead of a destructured prop, and {count()} in the markup. Each changed line pair lights up in turn.
